newsitem.title: DENMARK: Drunken Dane steals ambulance from hospital.
newsitem.headline: Drunken Dane steals ambulance from hospital.

text.p: Danish paramedics escorting a patient into a hospital emergency room got a shock on Saturday when a passer-by told them: "Somebody's taken your ambulance."

The national news agency Ritzau reported that a drunken 21-year-old had taken the vehicle, with the back doors still open. He drove over the suburban hospital's helicopter pad and out on the road into central Copenhagen.
Police gave chase and caught the errant driver after he had sideswiped several other vehicles. Ritzau said he was likely to face charges of theft, drunken driving and driving while unlicensed.
